definitions.short: a noose (for catching animals) (literally or figuratively); by implication, a hook (for the nose)
definitions.full: H4170. moqesh מוֺקֵשׁ noun masculine Prov 12:13 properly a bait or lure in a fowler's net; then figurative snare — absolute מוֺקֵשׁ Exod 10:7 15 t.; construct Prov 18:7 ; 20:25 ; plural מוֺקְשִׁים Psa 64:6 ; Job 40:24 ; מֹקְשִׁים Psa 140:6 ; construct מוֺקְשֵי 18:6 3 t.; מֹקְשֵׁי 2Sam 22:6 ; f. מֹקְשׁוֺת Psa 141:9 ; bait or lure , in a net for birds Amos 3:5 ; will not pierce nostril of hippopotamus Job 40:24 ; elsewhere figurative of what allures and entraps any one to disaster or ruin; Moses a snare to Egyptians Exod 10:7 (J); עָם מוֺקְשֵׁי Job 34:30 , of men who are the ruin of their people; idols and idol-worship a pernicious lure to Israel Exod 23:33 (JE), Deut 7:16 ; Judg 2:3 ; 8:27 ; Psa 106:36 ; so alliances with Canaanites Exod 34:12 (JE), Josh 23:13 (D); Michal, to David 1Sam 18:21 ; of ׳י as cause of ruin to evildoers Isa 8:14 ; of plots of wicked Psa 64:6 ; 140:6 (verb שִׁית ; || רֶשֶׁת חֲבָלִים, מַּח, ), 141:9 (|| מַּח ); a lure or snare for wicked in their transgressions Prov 29:6 ; Psa 69:23 (|| מַּח ); consisting in transgressions of lips Prov 12:13 , compare 18:7 ; 20:25 ; in wrathfulness 22:25 ; in fear of man 29:25 ; ׳מ מָוֶת Psa 18:6 = 2Sam 22:6 (|| שְׁאוֺל חֶבְלֵי ), Prov 13:14 ; 14:27 .
